name: Amazon ECS
description: AWS container orchestration service for deploying, managing, and scaling Docker containers without needing to manage the underlying cluster software.

name: Amazon EKS
description: Managed service for running Kubernetes clusters on AWS without needing to install and operate the Kubernetes control plane.

name: Azure Container Apps
description: Serverless hosting service on Azure for running containerized applications and microservices without managing underlying infrastructure or orchestration directly.

name: Docker
description: Platform for building, packaging, and running applications in lightweight, portable containers that bundle code and dependencies together.

name: Docker Compose
description: Tool for defining and running multi-container Docker applications using a single YAML configuration file to specify services, networks, and volumes.

name: Helm
description: Package manager for Kubernetes that uses charts to define, install, and upgrade complex applications and their dependencies.

name: Kubernetes
description: Open-source platform for automating the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications across clusters of machines.

name: Microsoft Hyper-V
description: Native hypervisor built into Windows for creating and managing virtual machines, enabling multiple operating systems to run on a single physical host.

name: OpenShift
description: Enterprise Kubernetes platform from Red Hat that adds developer and operational tooling on top of Kubernetes for building and deploying containerized applications.
